findings.description: The error alert text is effectively invisible. The [role="alert"] rule in the theme sets the text colour to --danger-bg (#fdecea), the same as the alert background, so 'Invalid credentials' renders as an empty pink box. The same rule affects every alert on the app.
repro: Enter username viewer-e393 and password wrong
Observe the red banner above the form has no readable text

findings.description: The category column and the table headers, the 'Signed in as' line and the mobile category text use the --muted colour #c3c8cd on white (about 1.7:1 contrast), far below WCAG AA 4.5:1. Category and column labels are hard to read, especially for low-vision users.
repro: Sign in as editor-541d or viewer-e393
Look at the Category column cells and the table headers, and the 'Signed in as' line
Compute colour contrast: rgb(195,200,205) on rgb(255,255,255)

notes: Tested: viewer and editor sign-in, expense list and totals (correct for all, incl. category filter), add and edit as editor with totals updating, validation of amount step, viewer 403 on add/edit/delete/create, layout at 360 px and 1280 px (no horizontal overflow, cards on mobile). Not tested: delete flow in depth, keyboard-only navigation end to end, focus order, screen-reader labels beyond form labels, and HTTP caching or performance.

cost.notes: estimate from 32116 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0003-$0.0039
